title: Saturating Integrator Model
constraints: Discrete-time integrator with gain `K` (parameter, default 0.1): on each rising edge `y <= clamp(y + K·x, −1.0, +1.0)`. Synchronous reset → `y = 0.0`.
The testbench uses K = 0.1 and K = 0.25. Not synthesizable (real numbers).
hints: Compute the new value first, then clamp it into [−1, 1].
Saturation models the limited output swing of an op-amp integrator. Without it, the model could reach values the real circuit never can.
This block is the heart of a sigma-delta modulator (see that problem).
